headline: Kerala HC sets aside assessment where DRP objection was filed outside Form 35A
reference: Arakkanatil Oommen Iype vs Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax (International Taxation), Kerala High Court, WP(C) No. 19984 of 2026, 2026:KER:89997, decided 19 November 2026
summary_points: Issue: Objection to a Section 144C draft assessment order was sent by email and portal reply, not in Form 35A; the AO then finalised the assessment under Section 147.
Held: Objections must ordinarily be filed in Form 35A, but the Court allowed one more opportunity since the petitioner had responded to the draft order.
The Court set aside the assessment order and directed the department to activate the portal within a week to enable filing.
The petitioner must file Form 35A within two weeks of that; the DRP must condone delay and decide afresh on merits.
who_is_affected: Eligible assessees, especially non-residents, who receive a draft assessment order under Section 144C and may file objections before the DRP.
action_required: File objections to a Section 144C draft order in Form 35A on the portal within the 30-day time limit, as informal replies or emails may not be recognised.

Kerala High Court: wrong form, but a second chance.

In Arakkanatil Oommen Iype vs DCIT (International Taxation), the petitioner, an NRI, received a draft assessment order under Section 144C. He responded by email and an online reply, but not in Form 35A. The objection never appeared on the department's portal, and the AO finalised the assessment under Section 147.

The Court accepted that Form 35A is the prescribed route. Even so, since the petitioner had responded to the draft order, it granted one more opportunity.

Directions: the assessment order is set aside, the portal is to be activated within a week, the petitioner must file Form 35A within two weeks after that, and the DRP must condone the delay and decide on merits.

Takeaway: do not rely on this relief. File Form 35A on the portal within 30 days of receiving a draft order, and keep proof of filing.
